# ServiceIsNotDefinedException

<link-summary>A service the script expected to be available is not: an advanced service left disabled, or a global that never got defined.</link-summary>

<web-summary>ServiceIsNotDefinedException — A service the script expected to be available is not: an advanced service left disabled, or a global that never got defined. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class ServiceIsNotDefinedException extends RuntimeException
```

A service the script expected to be available is not: an advanced service left disabled, or a global that never got defined.

Thrown by [`requireService`](requireService.md).

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new ServiceIsNotDefinedException("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ServiceIsNotDefinedException) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
